gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 diagnoses the cost of eigendecomposition for dense k-by-k matrices, not the failure to define kernel evaluations because scalar samples are used with a kernel declared on R^d for d>1.
ISSUE-002 concerns underestimated eigenvalue-computation complexity, whereas the gold issue concerns an executable experiment using six-dimensional samples with a kernel declared on R^7.
